authorization_basis: Root-directed successor to the V2 all-supplied student-pair recipe; worker science argv remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
Adds the seed-specific newly initialized family-head lineage and binds the static source-compatibility receipt without treating it as a successful checkpoint load.
Parent terminal checkpoint, actual student initializer-load check, complete cache and fresh root admission remain blocking dependencies.

scope.purpose: Train an own all-supplied-data GRU256 student pair from the newly fitted own all-data parent using the four-family source-sum distillation cache.
scope.fit_membership: The all-data validator and dataset pool include every supplied train and valid target group. Per-epoch optimizer exposure is a shuffled drop-last sample of this pool; 15 groups are omitted from each epoch.
scope.member_independence_note: Students use seeds3 and4 for separate training-order/dropout randomness and fresh seed-specific initialization of the added 8-row family head, but share the same seed3 all-data parent recurrent/main/auxiliary parameters and identical teacher cache. Do not claim independently initialized whole models.
scope.teacher_history_limit: Current teacher family fits use clean fold0 membership; all-data student fitting includes groups outside those teacher-fit populations. This is a declared heterogeneous-teacher analogue, not a full-data-teacher reference replication. Queue a separate own all-data heterogeneous teacher cohort after this endpoint.
scope.population_membership: The complete pool is 10,606 train groups plus1,873 valid groups (12,479 total), with the 468 exposed valid groups included. Complete pool membership is not a claim that every group is consumed by every epoch.

epoch_exposure.sampler: Default PyTorch RandomSampler because batch-order remains random and DataLoader shuffle=True.
epoch_exposure.omitted_group_ids: Not materialized by the frozen trainer; the omitted identities vary with each student's seed/order. Per-epoch sample_order_identity records the sampler/RNG state, batch size and drop_last flag.
epoch_exposure.claim_limit: Do not claim every pool group is trained in each epoch or that all groups are observed over the two-epoch horizon.

parent_dependency.required_checkpoint_policy: fixed zero-based epoch3 from the frozen four-epoch parent run.
parent_dependency.binding_rule: After successful terminal fit, root must verify run provenance, all-supplied membership, fixed epoch3, source ancestry and checkpoint bytes; a root-approved successor must bind the terminal receipt and model_ep3.pt SHA256 before cache/student admission.
parent_dependency.initialization_independence_note: Both students share this one own all-data parent checkpoint for their recurrent trunk and compatible main/auxiliary parameters. Each student creates a fresh seed-specific 8-row family head. Different family-head initialization and training RNG do not make the pair independent whole-model initializations.

model_output_layout.student_source_v3: 23 output rows, including a newly initialized 8-row family head
model_output_layout.inheritance: The recurrent trunk and compatible parent main/auxiliary parameters are initialized from the shared parent checkpoint; the added family head is fresh and seed-specific.
model_output_layout.verification_gate: After parent terminal, load the exact model_ep3.pt with the frozen source-v3 student loader, assert the permitted key/shape mapping and finite tensors, and persist a small checkpoint-load receipt before any student fit.

source.source_relation_to_parent: Students use sealed source-v3. Parent retry3 was trained from sealed source-v2. Root verified the listed model/feature/propensity/data/training-state/optimizer modules byte-identical; the source snapshots differ in trainer, cache builder, cache module and focused tests. The actual epoch3 checkpoint has not yet been loaded through the student path; that remains a hard gate.
source.source_independence: Project-owned implementation and weights; no teammate code or model weights.

cache_membership.membership_gate: Cache builder and validator require each supplied train/valid target row exactly once in target-index order, with no fill/sort/positional fallback. This is cache coverage; it does not change student DataLoader drop_last exposure.

teacher_cache_dependency.main_target: source variant: unnormalized weighted sum of the eight teacher predictions (coefficient sum0.8125).
teacher_cache_dependency.family_targets: Mean raw predictions per family in declared family order; each family's own pair is averaged; no clip2.
teacher_cache_dependency.resource_status: Successor cache contract requests 1 CPU/8GB after parent terminal; it is not approved or launched. Require complete cache metadata/arrays and fresh root admission.

student_architecture.family_head_initialization: fresh, seed-specific student initialization; absent from the parent checkpoint

recipe.family_loss: Equal four-family weighted-MSE heads with raw per-family mean teacher targets.
recipe.throughput_mode: --fast; zero loader workers; source fast mode uses verified pinned/prefetch/fused optimizer/propensity-cache path.
recipe.student_pair_ancestry: Both train from the same parent ep3 and same all-data teacher cache. Recurrent and compatible main/auxiliary parent weights are shared; the added 8-output family head is freshly initialized separately under each student seed. Pair members are not independent whole-model draws.

data_loader.sampler: RandomSampler via DataLoader shuffle=True; source batch-order default random
data_loader.trainer_records: sample_order_identity binds sampler class, batch size, drop_last and pre-iteration RNG state; it does not list omitted group IDs.

data.fresh_launch_requires: Recheck file/stat bindings against the current source before cache materialization and student admission; do not read/re-hash full Parquet during this recipe freeze.

resource_request.resource_basis: Closest completed H230 batch16/chunk2000 family student and family-off control used 9,000,000,000-byte worker reservations; both peaked at8,999,997,440 bytes with zero worker OOM/kill. This is a proposed measured bound, not a fit authorization.
resource_request.controller: scripts/bandit_resources.py launch; one GPU lock; parent CPU cap and RAM headroom must be measured afresh after cache build; root admission required.
resource_request.current_slice_policy: Preserve corrected live CPU policy, memory.high18GB, memory.max20GB, swap0 and one-GPU-worker ceiling; no limit increases in this packet.

runtime_estimate.all_data_batch_scale: 779/746 = 1.0442359, based on observed all-data parent outer batches per epoch versus clean-fold student fits.
runtime_estimate.estimate_limit: Linear row-count scaling is a planning estimate, not observed all-data student throughput; no cache-build or export time included.

cache_build_budget.note: Comparable cache was clean-fold and chunk size2; it does not establish all-data chunk-size1 memory or runtime.

completion_checks: Require successful controller terminal receipt, worker exit0, heartbeat and zero worker/parent-local OOM/kill deltas.
Verify provenance contains exact source-v3 trainer hash, exact argv, common parent run plus checkpoint SHA, propensity checkpoint SHA and all-data cache metadata SHA.
Verify fixed model_ep1.pt and model.pt match selected fixed epoch and provenance hashes.
Require training history epochs0 and1 only, both with evaluation withheld; training_state.pt present.

Verify full loader pool identity and row-group hashes: 10,606 train and1,873 valid, including all exposed evaluation groups. Separately verify 779 completed batches and12,464 unique sequences consumed per epoch with drop_last=True;15 pool rows are omitted by the seeded shuffle each epoch. Do not claim every pool row is trained per epoch.
Make no heldout score claim; independent grader/root owns any later prediction comparison.
launch_preconditions: Retry3 parent fit succeeds; root binds its terminal receipt and exact model_ep3.pt SHA256.

Root source-compatibility receipt is static evidence only; actual source-v3 loader must successfully load the parent ep3 checkpoint and verify the declared missing/new family-head mapping before training.
The V2 full-membership teacher cache contract is separately root-approved and admitted after the parent fit, then completes with all eight arrays and validated realized metadata.
Fresh Parquet/input identity and row-group membership checks pass for the cache build and each student launch.
Root reviews and approves the exact successor contract binding parent, checkpoint-load receipt, cache metadata and source hashes.
Fresh current aggregate CPU/RAM/swap/VRAM admission passes for seed3, then separately for seed4; no concurrent local GPU worker.
Do not reinterpret complete pool membership as per-epoch exposure: 15 of 12,479 groups are omitted by each shuffled drop-last epoch.
failure_policy: Preserve every terminal attempt, receipt, log, checkpoint and state file. Infrastructure failure is not negative scientific evidence. Any retry requires a new run/attempt ID and root-reviewed contract; no silent seed, parent, cache, epoch, recipe or checkpoint substitution.

supersedes_contract.reason: V3 adds the parent-versus-student output/head ancestry and binds the static source compatibility receipt while explicitly leaving actual checkpoint loading unverified; scientific worker argv and corrected V2 sampler/exposure accounting are unchanged.

decision_basis.decision: Use the common own seed3 all-data parent ep3 for both students seeds3/4; describe the shared ancestry and retain the separate teacher-history follow-up.
